artifact: GRENDEL BC4 dark-scalar sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: High-statistics publication campaign completed 2026-07-15: 86-point mass grid, 400000-parent high-pT importance-sampled FONLL pool per B species (1200000 scalar events per mass across B+, B0, and Bs; tilt scale 5 GeV, 50% nominal mixture, seed 42), and 100 decay/reconstruction samples per detector-entering scalar.
correction: Supersedes the 2026-07-12 600000-event curve. The denser importance-sampled production pool removes visible upper-edge Monte Carlo fluctuations while retaining the daughter beta = p/E timing correction and the 0.14-0.20 GeV electron-only extension.

hypothesis.model: PBC BC4: Higgs-portal dark scalar, mixing only (no quartic)

physics_inputs.production: inclusive b -> X_s S (Winkler arXiv:1809.01876 eq. A7) summed over B+, B0, and Bs; FONLL 14 TeV bottom kinematics (NNPDF4.0 NLO); two-body B -> K S recoil
physics_inputs.decays: Winkler dispersive hadronic widths (digitized Fig. 4) below 2 GeV, perturbative spectator model above; analytic leptonic widths

analysis.reconstruction: shared GRENDEL 4-hit two-track vertex reconstruction and PR #13 selection, imported from higgs/ and hnl/ (timing chi2 with daughter beta = p/E)

column_contract.u2_min: lower sin^2 theta edge of the excluded island
column_contract.u2_max: upper sin^2 theta edge of the excluded island; NaN when u2_max_open is true
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass (peak_N < 3)
column_contract.peak_N: signal yield at the optimal mixing
column_contract.ctau_sin2th1_m: scalar ctau at sin^2 theta = 1, metres
column_contract.event_ess_columns: importance-weight effective event counts at the lower edge, peak, and upper edge

topology.finite_threshold_tips: Every adjacent finite sensitive/insensitive transition is closed by log-yield/log-coupling interpolation at N_signal = 3.

numerical_validation.interpretation: The six-million-event controls retain sensitivity at 3.75 GeV and independently reject 3.80 and 3.85 GeV. Their interpolated closure agrees with the published central closure within 0.006 GeV, so the high-mass endpoint is not a finite-pool artifact.

closure_note: The deepest point is at the f0(980) enhancement of the dispersive hadronic width. The island ends before the B -> K S kinematic endpoint because the inclusive b -> X_s S yield falls below three events at every mixing; log-yield interpolation between the 3.70 and 3.80 GeV central grid rows places the closure at 3.7975 GeV.
